review.imagery: Root reviewed all43 revised brochure pages,26 earlier brochure pages,4 earlier drawing-pack pages,28 qualifying revised native resources,43 earlier candidates and20 current website candidates. Selected32 genuine source renders comprise7 current originals,15 revised resources and10 earlier resources. The current Al Naseem frontage is the listing image. Decorative textures, palm shadows, icons, logo, generic people and duplicate views were excluded. Several current interior scenes also appear in Nawayef East sources. Public source/caption/floor notes identify shared concept designs, whose selected-villa application remains unverified. Earlier design scope is explicit. Original native image bytes remain preserved.
review.floorPlans: Root read all16 delivered whole sheets and enlarged six area panels. Revised four/five/six-bedroom internal BUA516/587/639m² and external153/195/143m² are separate, not a per-floor total. Earlier four/five/six-bedroom ground320/345/345 and first170/215/275 sum to printed490/560/620m², excluding parking. Earlier and revised editions have different area definitions and no equivalence was inferred. Original paired ground/first layouts, plot location keys, room schedules, staff rooms and notices remain intact. Staff rooms do not increase bedrooms. The four original map/master-plan spreads preserve edition context. Three complete PDFs retain physical-page links and honest broker-mirror labels.
review.location: Root read the complete current official regional map and four original whole brochure regional/master-plan sheets. Six current destination estimates were read directly from the Al Naseem map. The current HTML incorrectly gives the map a Maysan alt label, but the actual original image clearly identifies Al Naseem Community and its polygon. No map title was inferred from that incorrect alt. Nawayef East and West remain distinct communities. Proposed island amenities do not establish current operational status, private access or included charges. No exact villa pin, journey mode, kilometre distance or live route was inferred.
review.provenance: Normal-GET dated receipts preserve current official HTML, website originals and maps and three original broker-hosted PDFs with byte counts and SHA256. Native resources and complete physical sheets were visually reviewed by root. Original PDFs and lossless complete-sheet delivery retain full content. Existing text research, commercial qualifiers and all protected IDs, slugs, aliases and ownership remain unchanged.

unavailable: Contracted villa/plot, final measured area and applicable edition, villa-specific finish schedule, amenity entitlements, entrance coordinates, live routes and kilometre journeys remain unverified. Earlier and revised area definitions are distinct.
